content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-227. - Veterinarians and animal hospitals.
content.summary:
This article shall not apply to and will not be construed to require a kennel license
               for a licensed veterinarian to operate an animal hospital.
(Code 1981, § 6-106; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
